catalog.method: Plain GET, no headers, no auth, on a single-line Base64 blob. Outer XXTEA (delta 772515655, static key from MainDetail.b(), see thaivpn.py) -> JSON; inner Base64 fields decoded at runtime (ServerIP, Username, Password, PublicKey, UDPConfig, setOpenVPN, Sni, Payload, SquidProxy, ServerDNS, V2Ray). Leftover encoded values, if any, are kept verbatim with a decryptionStatus block (Katiba shape).
catalog.notes: No download API in the result JSON. Live re-fetch byte-identical to the delivered sample.

files.method: profile.json is the same encrypted JSON as the catalog (Base64 + XXTEA, same key). NOT wired to engine.py: the file suffix is json and registering a json engine would claim every .json import; no filename-scoped route exists. Ships for operator/manual use and dossier round-trip verification.
